new_project: Target architecture and technology choices are approved before development begins.
Customer stakeholders provide timely decisions and approvals.
Customer-provided test data or environments are available when needed.
Deployment access and release approval are provided.
Unknown or unresolved scope may require estimate revision.
Third-party licensing and usage fees are excluded unless listed.
enhancement: Existing source code and environments are accessible.
Existing production behavior remains stable before work begins.
Existing interfaces remain materially unchanged unless identified in scope.
Deployment access and release approval are provided.
Unknown scope may require estimate revision.
Third-party licensing and usage fees are excluded unless listed.
production_support: Initial scope may cover investigation and root-cause analysis.
Remediation may require a separate estimate.
Logs, monitoring data, access, and incident details will be provided.
Resolution depends on reproducibility and third-party dependencies.

ai_enabled: Approved data sources are available and permitted for use.
AI output receives the selected level of human review.
Model-provider charges are excluded unless explicitly included.
Evaluation thresholds must be agreed before production approval.
Material model, provider, or grounding changes may require reevaluation.

human_review_templates.Always: AI output will always be reviewed by a person before use.
human_review_templates.Sometimes: AI output will be reviewed by a person for higher-risk cases; routine output may not be reviewed individually.
human_review_templates.No: AI output will not be routinely reviewed by a person before use -- this should be revisited if risk increases.
human_review_templates.Not yet decided: The level of human review for AI output has not yet been decided and should be confirmed before production use.

unknown_scope_item_template: The status of "{item}" is not yet known and may require estimate revision once confirmed.
systems_involved_template: Work involving {system} assumes necessary access, credentials, and documentation will be made available.
excluded_scope_item_template: "{item}" is treated as excluded from this scope; if needed later, it will require a separate estimate.

system_context_templates.New system: This is treated as new development; no existing system constraints apply unless separately identified.
system_context_templates.Existing system: Existing system behavior and interfaces are assumed stable unless a change is identified in scope.
system_context_templates.Not yet known: System context (new vs. existing) is not yet confirmed and may affect scope once known.

ai_data_template: AI is expected to use {data_type}; access to and permitted use of this data must be confirmed before work begins.
contract_term_template: The requested delivery term of {term} is a planning and commercial boundary only and does not guarantee a final schedule.
dependency_provided_template: The following known dependency must be resolved before or during delivery: {dependency}.
